facts.fact: 上百条巨龙大小颜色各异，从越海的浪涛下升起，扑向凯萨斯叛军。
facts.anchor: A hundred dragons in all sizes and colors, emerging from beneath the waves

facts.fact: 另一支潜伏的中队一轮齐射直接命中飑牢之心，核心碎裂冒烟。
facts.anchor: Direct hits were scored on the Squallfast hearts, which shattered and began to smoke

facts.fact: 弓形小艇撞进地面，碎成几十片，两人靠影门屏障落在沙石上。
facts.anchor: The bowrider crashed into the ground hard enough that it fragmented into dozens of pieces

facts.fact: 三名穿影铸军团甲胄的人走进塔拉辛的视野，替她挡下逼近的士兵。
facts.anchor: Three figures clad in the armor of the Shadowforged Legion stepped into

facts.fact: 她擦掉眼上的血之后，月亮被阴影啃缺的边缘仍在，月食降临。
facts.anchor: that shadow-bitten edge was still there

facts.fact: 利苏的剑没入塔拉辛的腹部。
她把匕首直直捅进利苏的身体。
facts.anchor: she drove it straight into Lisu

facts.fact: 她说完「选择你」与「我爱你」之后滑入黑暗，滑进一种近乎安宁的所在。
facts.anchor: She slipped away into the darkness, into something that was like peace
